text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oof, a scab. ...Looks like a pretty tough 
one, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Were we going to see Grandmother next 
week? Or was it this week?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"What am I gonna do if it doesn't heal by 
then...?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Well, guess I'll put on some gloves. ...I 
hope they don't notice.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer was feeling self-conscious 
about her skin breaking out.
